title: Niagara Falls Canada Tour, Boat, Skylon Tower & Maple Tasting
includes: Journey Behind the Falls or Niagara Takes Flight *if Boat is closed in off season*
Pre-reserved Niagara Falls Boat Cruise ticket "if option selected"
Intimate, small-group tour experience groups are limited to 6 guests to ensure quality interaction
Hotel pickup and drop-off in the downtown Niagara Falls area
Ride on the yellow bug elevators at Skylon Tower Observation Deck "if option selected"
Visit to the "Maple Trail" which includes a maple syrup and chocolate tour and tasting
Recyclable Mist Poncho (keep dry from the mist of the Falls)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Schedule Flexibility – We do our best to keep to schedule, but times may vary due to traffic, weather, or other unexpected delays.
Comfortable walking footwear – Wear comfortable clothing and shoes suitable for walking and potential water exposure from the boat tour.
Weather-appropriate layers – Dress in layers and bring a light rain jacket - you'll experience both outdoor sightseeing and misty boat conditions.
Prepare to get wet – The Voyage to the Falls cruise provides ponchos, but you may still feel the spray. Embrace the mist—it's part of the magic!
Protect electronics – Use a waterproof pouch or zip-lock bag to keep phones and cameras dry during the boat experience.
E-Tickets Accepted – Show your mobile voucher to the guide at boarding.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: A trip to Niagara Falls is not complete without a signature ride on the great Niagara City Cruises. Whether you’re traveling with family, your significant other, or friends, this famous Niagara Falls boat ride is a “must-do” while visiting the area. Experience the refreshing mist on your skin as you take a magical ride along the Niagara River. Niagara City Cruises departs from the Canadian side of the Falls and passes by the Great Gorge, American Falls, Bridal Veil Falls, and Canadian Horseshoe Falls. Along the way, take in aerial views from the observation deck at Skylon Tower, and enjoy a narrated driving tour along Niagara Parkway with stunning viewpoints.
